objects.name: base
objects.prompt: Porta palestra  Wide heavy school gymnasium entrance door, 1990s institutional design, significantly wider than a classroom door, double-leaf construction, painted dark muted blue or green metal, narrow vertical reinforced glass windows in both leaves, sturdy push handles, slightly scratched lower sections from years of school use. Closed, frontal elevation.

objects.name: base
objects.prompt: Blocco giubbini — piccolo  Group of 4 children's and young teenagers' jackets hanging closely together from simple wall hooks: padded jacket, lightweight coat, denim-style jacket and simple windbreaker. Muted varied 1990s colors, different lengths and silhouettes. No people, no separate coat rack, jackets hanging naturally against an invisible wall line.

objects.prompt: Porta metallica corridoio — aperta  Exact matching version of the large institutional metal corridor door, now open approximately 70 degrees. objects.prompt: . Blocco giubbini — grande  Dense group of 7–8 middle-school students' coats and jackets hanging from a long row of simple metal wall hooks. objects.prompt: Finestra alta del corridoio  Wide high-mounted institutional corridor window, shorter vertically than a classroom window, several rectangular glass panes in an aged painted metal frame, typical of a 1980s–1990s European public school. Designed to sit high on a corridor wall.

objects.prompt: Porta laboratorio  Distinctive 1990s Italian school laboratory door, larger and more technical-looking than an ordinary classroom door.
